description:
The CLI currently has two separate tuning command structures that should be unified:

Current (inconsistent):
- `benchbox create-sample-tuning --platform duckdb` (top-level, 20 chars)
- `benchbox df-tuning create-sample --platform polars` (nested group)
- `benchbox df-tuning validate config.yaml`
- `benchbox df-tuning show-defaults --platform polars`

Proposed (unified):
- `benchbox tuning init --platform duckdb` (SQL platforms)
- `benchbox tuning init --platform polars --mode dataframe` (DataFrame platforms)
- `benchbox tuning validate config.yaml --platform polars`
- `benchbox tuning defaults --platform polars`

This consolidation improves discoverability, reduces cognitive load, and provides
a consistent interface for all tuning-related operations.
